about: What names a sub-agent (ADR 0103, decision 17): the engine's label (apps/agents/engine/src/lanes.rs) and the window's labelOf (apps/agents/pane/src/thread/subagents.ts). `siblings` are the IDs of those started beside it, in order; `id` is its own. Both tests read these cases.
